evidence: Inspected the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 38 is check 37, 'A later dimension doesn't assume a pristine seed after an earlier dimension mutated the shared running app.' Internal Quality Checks row 38 repeats the requirement and has no additional populated annotation. Applied frozen Harbor SKILL.md, quality-checks.md:153-154, staged-task-contract.md (test.sh, judge.toml, prompt.md/app_context.md), deterministic-checks.md (scoring-policy, rubric-schema, prompt and independence recipes), and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md. All task paths below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/. The harness starts the app with one APP_DB (tests/test.sh:97-111), reuses that DB on restart (160-189), and runs gates then scored serially without an intervening database reset (203-227). Thus the shared-state premise is real. Render prohibits durable writes (tests/gates/render/prompt.md:17 and judge.toml:27). Constraints creates a unique 'CW gate ' title, records actual identity/fields, and leaves it saved; it explicitly forbids an exact total library count (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29). The shared app_context.md:24 says 'Do not assume an empty library, alter the gate record or reset data', specifies scenario-owned titles, current state/revision refresh, one dedicated Polish setup record and no Visual saved-record mutations. Functional repeats 'Use one continuing public database' and leaves unknown gate/unrelated records untouched (tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:19); S01 accepts an app example or previously loaded snippet and expressly tolerates the gate record (119). Its storage scenarios create distinct records and observe current values: S21 at 397-403, S22 captures the complete current library before restart and compares that captured state after it (409-413), S23 captures real revisions and refreshes the baseline for its second conflict (421-425), S24 refreshes state after unexpected mutations (432-436). Theme checks capture the starting theme rather than requiring a default (442). Inspected all 64 Functional outcome descriptions; none adds a pristine seed, fixed initial library total, default revision or inherited generated identity requirement. Polish explicitly says 'Read the current application state; earlier dimensions may have changed it' (tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:31-32), creates its own recognisable keyboard fixture rather than depending on another dimension's private identity (43-47), and tolerates empty console/library states with positive setup where needed (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:68,77). Visual says 'Use the content and saved library that are currently present' (tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:37) and that earlier mutations/legitimate empty states are not visual defects (50-51); all six Visual descriptors concern currently rendered surfaces. The actual seed has an empty snippets array; read-only title-footprint analysis found no collision between Functional's fixed scenario titles and the gate namespace. Considered a conforming implementation that opens a previously saved snippet, retains the gate plus Functional records, and begins in either theme: the explicit current-state wording admits it. Also considered a broken shell returning a canned empty seed or only the earlier gate record: it cannot supply the newly authored gate write/read or Polish's independently created saved-source keyboard readback. No credible row-37 false-fail or false-pass witness remains. Raw supporting observation: the bound golden surface-results.json records 'Saved snippets 13', keyboard readback of console.log('keyboard-owned-control');, actual example-source change, and Complete feedback after earlier storage scenarios. Its drivers/launch_workflow.py:65-83 executes Functional pre/restart/post before surface_flow.cjs without replacing the database; surface_flow.cjs:14-25 creates its own gate and keyboard fixtures and actually navigates to the saved source. Verified RESULTS.json SHA256 ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09 against raw-evidence-index.json; its Functional prompt and judge hashes match the frozen files, all 22 recorded app-file hashes match the frozen app, and both cited driver hashes match. This is limited scripted evidence of later surfaces operating on a populated mutated database, not the configured dimension-order judge run. Full configured judge runtime, Oracle and target-model results remain unmeasured; this source-level Pass makes no claim about them.
